# Licenses of the bundled libraries

What `vendor/` holds is other people's work, bundled as its licenses allow. Their texts, as the
packages carry them (gathered by `dev/build-licenses.mjs`). PDF.js: `pdfjs/LICENSE`.

`mermaid.min.js` is Mermaid's own bundle and holds the libraries Mermaid is built on as well
(among them d3, dagre, cytoscape, DOMPurify, lodash, khroma, stylis, dayjs); KaTeX's fonts are under
the SIL Open Font License 1.1. Their notices: <https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/blob/develop/package.json>
and <https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX/tree/main/fonts>.
